set -e
cd /srv/interleaved/app
git fetch origin main -q && git checkout main -q && git pull --ff-only origin main -q
git log -1 --format="HEAD %h %s"
set -a; . /srv/interleaved/build.env; set +a
sudo docker build -f Dockerfile.hostvm -t interleaved:staging-partlevel \
  --build-arg NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY="$NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY" \
  --build-arg NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL="$NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL" . 2>&1 | tail -12
echo BUILD_OK

set -e
sudo sed -i "s#image: interleaved:staging-parallel#image: interleaved:staging-partlevel#" /srv/interleaved-staging/docker-compose.yml
grep -n "image:" /srv/interleaved-staging/docker-compose.yml
cd /srv/interleaved-staging && sudo docker compose up -d --force-recreate 2>&1 | tail -2
sleep 12; curl -s -m 10 -o /dev/null -w "http %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3001/
sudo docker logs --tail 5 interleaved-staging 2>&1 | tail -5
cd /srv/audit; date +%s > /tmp/burst2_start; python3 mcp.py 3001 generation_start "$(cat /tmp/burst.json)" 300

cd /srv/audit; S=$(cat /tmp/burst2_start); echo "elapsed $(( $(date +%s) - S ))s"; python3 mcp.py 3001 generation_run_status "{\"runId\":\"0343daf8-645f-4f46-aa4a-2f35486fd4e9\"}" 400000 > /tmp/b2.json; python3 - <<"PY"
import json
from collections import Counter
d=json.load(open("/tmp/b2.json"))
print("status",d["status"],"total",d["total"],"kept",d["kept"],"rejected",d["rejected"],"failed",d["failed"])
print(Counter(t["status"] for t in d["tasks"]))
print("types",Counter(t["type"] for t in d["tasks"] if t["status"]=="kept"))
c=Counter()
for t in d["tasks"]:
    if t["status"]=="rejected":
        for i in t["issues"]: c[i[:64]]+=1
for k,v in c.most_common(6): print("  ",v,"x",k)
PY

sudo docker logs --tail 60 interleaved-staging 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|429|timeout|abort|maxRetries|warn" | tail -12; echo ===; sudo docker stats --no-stream --format "{{.Name}} cpu={{.CPUPerc}} mem={{.MemUsage}}" interleaved-staging

set -e

AI_MODEL_SECOND=kilo/nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl:free
AI_MAX_PARALLEL=60
AI_MAX_PARALLEL_PER_PROVIDER=30
GEN_CONCURRENCY=60
MAX_RUN_QUESTIONS=300
EOF
sudo chown 1001:1001 /srv/interleaved-staging/override.env; sudo chmod 640 /srv/interleaved-staging/override.env
cd /srv/interleaved-staging && sudo docker compose up -d --force-recreate 2>&1 | tail -2
sleep 12; curl -s -m 10 -o /dev/null -w "http %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3001/
sudo docker exec interleaved-staging env | grep -E "AI_MAX_PARALLEL|GEN_CONCURRENCY"
cd /srv/audit; date +%s > /tmp/burst3_start; python3 mcp.py 3001 generation_start "$(cat /tmp/burst.json)" 300

cd /srv/audit; S=$(cat /tmp/burst3_start); echo "elapsed $(( $(date +%s) - S ))s"; python3 mcp.py 3001 generation_run_status "{\"runId\":\"23f180fc-33da-4cdc-8e54-cfc6ffbc1c51\"}" 400000 > /tmp/b3.json; python3 - <<"PY"
import json
from collections import Counter
d=json.load(open("/tmp/b3.json"))

print("kept types",Counter(t["type"] for t in d["tasks"] if t["status"]=="kept"))
c=Counter()
for t in d["tasks"]:

for k,v in c.most_common(6): print("  ",v,"x",k)

sudo docker logs --since 8m interleaved-staging 2>&1 | grep -ciE "rate_limit|429"; echo "--- errors:"; sudo docker logs --since 8m interleaved-staging 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|failed|abort" | tail -5; echo "--- conns:"; sudo docker exec interleaved-staging sh -c "cat /proc/net/tcp | wc -l"

for M in mimo-v2.6-flash-free deepseek-v4.1-flash-free kilo/nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl:free; do
  code=$(curl -s -m 40 -o /tmp/r.json -w "%{http_code}" "$AI_BASE_URL/chat/completions" -H "Authorization: Bearer $AI_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"model\":\"$M\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"say ok\"}],\"max_tokens\":5}")
  echo "$M -> $code $(head -c 110 /tmp/r.json)"
done

set -a; . /tmp/ai.env; set +a
for M in qwen-3.8-max gemini-3.5-flash-free glm-4.7-free kimi-k2.7-free gpt-5.1-mini-free kilo/nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free; do

{"model":"MODEL","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Return {\"answer\":\"ok\"}"}],"max_tokens":50,"response_format":{"type":"json_schema","json_schema":{"name":"r","strict":true,"schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"answer":{"type":"string"}},"required":["answer"],"additionalProperties":false}}}}

set -a; . /tmp/ai.env; set +a
mk(){ cat <<JSON
{"model":"kilo/nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl:free","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Fill the JSON"}],"max_tokens":60,"response_format":{"type":"json_schema","json_schema":{"name":"t","strict":true,"schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"figure":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":$1,"properties":{"kind":{"type":"string"}},"required":["kind"]}},"required":["figure"],"additionalProperties":false}}}}
JSON
}
for V in true false; do
  code=$(curl -s -m 45 -o /tmp/t.json -w "%{http_code}" "$AI_BASE_URL/chat/completions" -H "Authorization: Bearer $AI_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$(mk $V)")
  echo "additionalProperties=$V -> $code $(head -c 120 /tmp/t.json)"
done

import json
d=json.load(open("/tmp/models.json"))
M=d.get("data") or d.get("models") or []
print("total",len(M))
free=[m for m in M if str(m.get("id","")).endswith(":free") or str(m.get("id","")).endswith("-free")]
print("free-ish",len(free))
for m in free[:60]:
    pid=m.get("id"); pr=m.get("pricing") or {}
    print(" ", pid, "|", {k:v for k,v in pr.items() if k in ("prompt","completion")} or "")
PY

set -a; . /tmp/ai.env; set +a
probe(){ M=$1; MODE=$2
 if [ "$MODE" = plain ]; then B="{\"model\":\"$M\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"say ok\"}],\"max_tokens\":5}";
 else B="{\"model\":\"$M\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"Give the JSON {\\\"answer\\\":\\\"ok\\\"}\"}],\"max_tokens\":60,\"response_format\":{\"type\":\"json_schema\",\"json_schema\":{\"name\":\"r\",\"strict\":true,\"schema\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"answer\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"answer\"],\"additionalProperties\":false}}}}"; fi
 T0=$(date +%s%3N); code=$(curl -s -m 60 -o /tmp/pr.json -w "%{http_code}" "$AI_BASE_URL/chat/completions" -H "Authorization: Bearer $AI_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$B"); T1=$(date +%s%3N)
 echo "$M [$MODE] -> $code $((T1-T0))ms $(head -c 90 /tmp/pr.json)"
}
for M in glm-5.3-flash-free mimo-v2.6-flash-free deepseek-v4.1-flash-free; do probe $M plain; probe $M schema; done
for M in kilo/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free kilo/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash-1019-free; do probe $M plain; probe $M schema; done

import json
d=json.load(open("/tmp/q2.json")); items=d.get("items") or d.get("questions") or []
items.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("createdAt") or "", reverse=True)
print("queue total",len(items))

    print("="*60)
    print(q["type"], q["marks"],"marks | modelAnswer:", (q.get("modelAnswer") or "NONE")[:90].replace("\n"," "))
